target.title: fix(reply): add 30s timeout to beforeDeliver to prevent lane deadlock (#103684)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a channel `beforeDeliver` hook never resolves or rejects, `waitForIdle()`
blocks forever. The `sendChain` is permanently stuck, subsequent replies are
never delivered, and the lane stays blocked with `pendingFinalDelivery`.
Reported on WhatsApp with `2026.6.11` / Node v24.18.0 / Raspberry Pi.

Fixes #103684.

## Why This Change Was Made

30s `Promise.race` timeout on `beforeDeliver`. A hung hook is treated as
silent cancellation — the dispatcher unblocks, cancelled count is incremented,
and the lane recovers. Additional safeguards: `clearTimeout` to prevent timer
leak, `Promise.resolve` wrapping (hook may return sync `null`), and
conditional `.catch()` to swallow post-timeout rejections.

## User Impact

**Before:** hung channel hook permanently blocks lane, requires restart
**After:** dispatcher unblocks after 30s, lane recovers automatically

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/103684-before-deliver-timeout` | Base: `upstream/main`

### Real behavior proof

The regression test constructs a `beforeDeliver` hook that never resolves.
Without the fix, `waitForIdle()` hangs forever. With the fix, the dispatcher
unblocks after 30s and the next reply is delivered.

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/before-deliver.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ cancels delivery before queueing when transformReplyPayload returns null
 ✓ cancels delivery when beforeDeliver returns null
 ✓ notifies appended cancellation observers when beforeDeliver returns null
 ✓ notifies cancellation when beforeDeliver throws before delivery
 ✓ allows modifying payload in beforeDeliver
 ✓ preserves payload metadata through beforeDeliver rewrites
 ✓ delivers normally without beforeDeliver
 ✓ unblocks the dispatcher when beforeDeliver never resolves (#103684)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
```

oxlint         → 0 errors
git diff --check → clean
```

```
